matches.title: Front End Engineer
matches.description: Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture . Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security? Cohesity is looking for a Front End Software Engineer to join one of our largest teams in Cloud Vertical. With millions of documents, terabytes of emails, and endless Teams conversations, we deal with unprecedented data volumes that require unique strategies and algorithms to process data efficiently. Keeping pace with the changing nature of products while ensuring seamless protection is a puzzle we solve every day. Our team tackles these challenges head-on with creativity, technical expertise, and a passion for excellence. Through mentorship, cross-training, and constant learning, you’ll grow your skills in ways you never imagined. Be part of a mission-critical team to protect the data that drives businesses across the world. As a Front End Software Engineer, you will be an individual contributor focused on delivering features with high quality, along with continuous quality improvements with the help of automation. Working on the UI, you’ll be expected to coordinate with Product Management and User Experience team on the mock-ups as well as with the backend engineers on the interfaces and end-to-end testing. There will be a large variety of features to work on including: distributed and parallel data flows, cloud services, asynchronous programming, performance optimization, infinite scalability, snapshots, resiliency, multiple protocols, and fault tolerance. We are a passionate team of customer obsessed and quality focused engineers with a desire to disrupt the way organizations manage and protect their data, to help them unleash the maximum value locked in their data. We are looking for an outstanding UI Engineer to expand our team of UI engineers that are excited about building quality products and delivering value to customers through simplifying the world of data management. HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE As part of this team, you will design and build massively distributed systems at web-scale. You’ll be building the UI that is closest to the customers when they are interacting with Cohesity’s hyper-converged, highly-scalable storage clusters. WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING 2+ years of developing and troubleshooting UI in large scale distributed systems BE/BTech degree in Computer Science with proficiency in data structures, algorithms, and software design. Master’s degree would be a plus. Strong understanding of UX and UI design principles Expertise in HTML, CSS and JavaScript Strong knowledge of front-end frameworks and libraries such as React, Angular Having worked on and understanding of large-scale engineering challenges and highly available distributed systems In-depth understanding of the entire web development process – design, development, and deployment Proficient understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to work around them Excellent analytical and multi-tasking skills Excellent written and spoken communication skills Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support decision making. #LI-DJ1 Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates: For information on personal data processing, please see our Privacy Policy . Equal Employment Opportunity Employer (EEOE) Cohesity is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status or any other category protected by law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us at 1-855-9COHESITY or recruiting@cohesity.com for assistance. In-Office Expectations Cohesity employees who are within a reasonable commute (e.g. within a forty-five (45) minute average travel time) work out of our core offices 2-3 days a week of their choosing. We strongly prefer candidates who are currently located in or near the designated job location. Candidates outside the area should apply only if they are committed to relocating prior to their start date and have the legal right to work in the job location.

matches.title: Software Development Engineer II
matches.description: Job Summary: As a Software Development Engineer II, you’ll build a world-class content viewing experience for our customers by solving complex technical problems and building systems which run at an enormous scale. The role is expected to design and deliver high-quality distributed applications and also keep an extremely high operational excellence bar to provide a seamless experience to our customers on the JioHotstar website and TV applications. About the team: At JioHotstar, the Viewer Experience (VX) org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end-to-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalization, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. We blend world-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalized, and engaging OTT experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building immersive, intelligent, and performant user experiences that delight a billion users, join us in shaping the future of streaming. Key responsibilities: Own and deliver end-to-end features, ensuring high performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility Collaborate with stakeholders of the product to deliver new user-facing features on the website/TV app You will ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and implement them You will build reusable code and cross-functional libraries in contributing to our extensive in-house Design system Document and demonstrate solutions by creating documentation, DFDs, code comments Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using best practices and participate in code reviews Skills and attributes for success: Strong experience in JavaScript Deep knowledge about how browsers work Deep understanding about design & architecture patterns Highly enthusiastic and enjoy learning new technologies and frameworks You know why a framework is necessary and know any of React, AngularJS etc Open source contribution is good to have Proficient understanding of code versioning tools Git Familiarity with front-end build tools, such as Grunt or Gulp Preferred education and experience: Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or a related field with 2-4 years of professional experience as a frontend developer with hands-on experience on Javascript.

matches.title: Software Development Engineer II - Web
matches.description: Job Summary: As a Software Development Engineer II, you’ll build a world-class platform for our customers by solving complex technical problems and building systems that run at scale. You will play a critical role in developing code and solving problems independently while shaping our next-gen solutions that drive our company's mission forward. We seek candidates with a passion for crafting elegant code and building innovative software solutions. Key responsibilities: Architecture & Design: Lead the design of complex front-end systems using modern frameworks (React.js, Next.js, and Typescript preferred) and state management libraries. Performance Engineering: Optimize web applications for maximum speed, scalability, and Core Web Vitals. Optimize startup time, rebuffering, memory usage, and rendering performance,PFR, startup time, errors, and engagement. Cross Browser: Ensure a seamless experience across desktop browsers, mobile web, and Smart TV web platforms (Tizen, webOS). Mentorship: Conduct rigorous code reviews and mentor junior/mid-level engineers on best practices and design patterns. Collaboration: Partner with Product Managers and UX Designers to translate wireframes into high-quality, reusable components. Streaming: Integrate player UI with video playback engines (HTML5, MSE, EME). Analytics & QoS: Design and integrate analytics and observability frameworks to track key metrics such as startup time, buffering ratio, rebuffer frequency, bitrate switches/drops, playback failures, and user engagement, enabling data-driven performance optimization and rollout decisions. Triaging Production issues: Ability to debug and resolve production issues under pressure, demonstrating a strong ownership mindset with a bias for performance and reliability, and delivering timely fixes that minimize customer impact. Security Compliance: Strong understanding of web security best practices, including XSS prevention, CSP, CORS, secure media playback, and DRM-related attack vectors. Skills and attributes for success: 2-4 years of professional experience in modern web development. Expert-level knowledge of TypeScript, React/Next.js, and CSS-in-JS (styled-components/Tailwind). Deep hands-on experience with HTML5 video players and SDKs such as Shaka Player, HLS.js, Video.js, and Dash.js, including customization of UI, buffering logic, error handling, and ABR behavior. Protocols: Expert knowledge of HLS and MPEG-DASH, including manifest structure, segmenting, DRM, and adaptive bitrate. Hands-on experience with modern build systems (Webpack, Vite, Rollup), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing (Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright), ensuring high-quality A/B experiments and production-ready releases. Preferred education and experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field. 2-4 years of Web development experience.
reasons: skills: react, typescript, html5, performance, webpack

matches.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
matches.description: Job Summary: As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will be responsible for bridging the gap between high-level business goals and hands-on execution. You will build scalable systems, define architectural blueprints, and actively mentor engineering teams across both front-end and back-end ecosystems. About the team: At JioHotstar, GenAI studios is an AI native, agile & fast-moving team focused on turning bold ideas into impactful features for professional film making products. From rapid prototyping of new concepts to building scalable platforms that power future growth, we thrive on experimentation and innovation. Our platform highlights creators and their narratives by giving them AI-powered systems using advanced machine learning and multimedia pipelines. As part of this team, you’ll work at the intersection of creativity and technology — building end-to-end experiences, experimenting with emerging tech, and shaping the future of entertainment content. Reporting To: Engineering Manager Key responsibilities: ● Design and build scalable, resilient microservices ● Own end-to-end delivery of complex fullstack projects, from technical design to deployment and monitoring ● Write high-quality, maintainable code, and ensure rigorous testing and fault tolerance ● Drive architectural decisions and influence long-term engineering strategy for the team ● Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into tech solutions ● Take ownership of operational excellence, including performance tuning, incident response, and root cause analysis ● Mentor junior engineers, conduct technical deep dives and code reviews, and foster a culture of knowledge sharing Skills and attributes for success: ● 4 -7 years of hands-on fullstack software development experience. ● Front-End Technologies: Expertise in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks like React.js, or Next.js. ● Back-End Technologies: Strong proficiency in server-side technology - Python, experience with Golang is an added advantage. ● Hands-on experience with relational/non-relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and cloud platforms (AWS or GCP). ● Tools & Practices: Deep understanding of Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, AI-assisted coding tools, and API design (REST) ● Exceptional leadership, communication, and presentation skills. ● Strong capability in prioritizing tasks and navigating ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
